property.name: IsEnabled
property.description-key: Enables or disables the Data Grid

property.name: apiRequestUrl
property.description-key: 1Staff Data url - look up to 1Staff Data Url

property.name: DisplayHeader
property.description-key: Whether to display the header of the data grid

property.name: HeaderText
property.description-key: The text displayed as the header of the data grid

property.name: DisplaySearch
property.description-key: Enables or disables the display of a search input

property.name: EmptyMessage
property.description-key: The message shown when no records are available

property.name: SelectionMode
property.description-key: Specifies the selection mode (e.g., single or multiple)

property.name: AllowSorting
property.description-key: Enables or disables sorting on columns

property.name: DefaultSort
property.description-key: Default sort applied on load. Format: fieldName, fieldName asc, or fieldName desc

property.name: AllowFiltering
property.description-key: Enables or disables filtering on columns

property.name: FieldConfigurations
property.description-key: Allows custom configurations to be set on column values

property.name: jsonData
property.description-key: Pass the full collection as JSON string using JSON(colAllInvoices)

property.name: ShrinkToFit
property.description-key: When enabled, the grid height collapses to fit its content instead of filling the allocated container height

property.name: ContentHeight
property.description-key: Actual rendered height of the grid in pixels. Use in Canvas Height formula: GridName.ContentHeight

property.name: EventName
property.description-key: Name of the last event fired by the grid (e.g. rowClick). Use in OnChange to react to row clicks.

property.name: SelectedRowData
property.description-key: JSON string of the clicked row data. Parse with ParseJSON() in Canvas.
